2. Primary Risk Drivers?

3. Financial Conditions Signal?

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech leading: XLK (1W: +3.38% | 1M: +16.63%) ABOVE TREND. Financials showing strength: XLF (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +0.72%) ABOVE TREND. Communications and Staples weak: XLC (1W: -4.99% | 1M: -6.70%) BELOW TREND, XLP (1W: -3.50% | 1M: -1.30%) BELOW TREND — style: Growth/momentum bias with select cyclicals.

5. US vs Global?

6. Speculative Appetite?
Mixed-to-soft: IWM (1W: -0.01% | 1M: +3.34%) CORRECTION shows small-cap pause, ARKK (1W: +0.27% | 1M: -0.09%) RECOVERY mild; crypto risk off: IBIT (1W: -12.84% | 1M: -18.50%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial/comms metals supportive: CPER (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +9.36%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND. Gold softer: GLD (1W: -0.36% | 1M: -1.67%) BELOW TREND. Natural gas strength notable: UNG (1W: +1.93% | 1M: +13.91%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND.

8. Energy Trend?
Mixed but recovering: XLE (1W: +3.16% | 1M: -1.18%) RECOVERY and BNO (1W: +2.24% | 1M: -9.80%) RECOVERY, while commodity energy breadth is uneven — monitor continuation in prices.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: XLK (1W: +3.38% | 1M: +16.63%) ABOVE TREND and SPY (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +4.60%) ABOVE TREND. Divergences concentrated in thematic/commodity names (TAN CORRECTION, IWM CORRECTION, SLV CORRECTION) — minor divergences, no major cross-core divergence.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor selective exposure to growth and cyclical leadership (XLK, XLF, CPER) while reducing exposure to high-volatility crypto and weak defensives (IBIT, XLC). Bonds neutral — TLT (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.48%) ABOVE TREND signals stable duration exposure.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

BULLISH: XLK (1W: +3.38% | 1M: +16.63%) ABOVE TREND, XLF (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +0.72%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLC (1W: -4.99% | 1M: -6.70%) BELOW TREND, XLP (1W: -3.50% | 1M: -1.30%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +9.36%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND, UNG (1W: +1.93% | 1M: +13.91%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: GLD (1W: -0.36% | 1M: -1.67%) BELOW TREND, CORN (1W: -5.38% | 1M: -8.93%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (fear complacency marker); HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health reference); XLK/XLF 2.0 (growth vs value pivot); CPER +10% (momentum threshold).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive with mixed confirmations from SPY (1W: +0.33% | 1M: +4.60%) ABOVE TREND and VXX (1W: -2.84% | 1M: -15.21%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Tech and select cyclicals showing strength (XLK, XLF, CPER); key risk is thematic/commodity divergences and sharp weakness in crypto (IBIT) to monitor.
